Connections Volume 4

4 Groups of 4 Words with a Common Link

Find the hidden connection. Group the words. Feel very smug about it.

Each puzzle gives you 16 words – your job is to sort them into 4 secret groups of 4, all sharing a common link. Simple to explain, sneaky to solve, and the kind of puzzle that turns "just one more" into an hour has gone by.
